label: Formulated the four orders of simulacra and the concept of hyperreality in Simulacra and Simulation
description: Jean Baudrillard formulated and introduced the concept of "Simulacra, Simulation & Hyperreality", which became a seminal contribution in metaphysics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in metaphysics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Contemporary & Post-Structural as part of Jean Baudrillard's canonical writings.

label: Influenced Han's critique of hyper-communication, digital transparency, and the vanishing of otherness in late capitalism
description: Byung-Chul Han was fundamentally influenced by Jean Baudrillard's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Jean Baudrillard's perspective to Byung-Chul Han's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Contemporary & Post-Structural era.
